commits.subject: design-system(design): Button primary background tenant primary → --gv-error [AI-assisted]
commits.body:
Button/index.tsx, the primary style's background, from the city's primary
colour (theme.colors.tenantPrimary, --gv-color-tenant-primary) to
var(--gv-error). A swap from the workbench, sent as a test: every primary
button turns the error red, on every platform and page that renders one.

polished cannot darken a CSS variable, so hover and active darken a var()
colour in CSS (color-mix with black, 12% each step) through a small shade()
helper; every other style still darkens with polished as before.

Visual compare: 27 Button stories, 12 diffs, all primary-style stories
(Default, Hover, Focus, Active, Disabled, Loading, Long content, RTL,
Keyboard, Primary, Primary with icon, Button link). The other 15 styles
are unchanged. Axe: no new criticals, no contrast finding. eslint ok,
jest 10 passed, typecheck ok.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: design-system(setup): the app loads the tokens stylesheet [AI-assisted]
commits.body:
app/containers/App/index.tsx imports design-system/tokens/tokens.css, so
var(--gv-*) reads resolve on the platform. The file only declares custom
properties on :root: nothing renders differently until a component
reads one.
